name: AnimatedPositioned
description: A widget that automatically animates changes to a child's position within a Stack over a given duration and curve. Useful for smooth repositioning without manual animation controllers.
how_to_use:
AnimatedPositioned(
  left: _isMoved ? 200 : 50,
  top: _isMoved ? 300 : 100,
  duration: const Duration(seconds: 1),
  curve: Curves.easeInOut,
  child: Container(
    width: 100,
    height: 100,
    color: Colors.blue,
  ),
);

properties.name: child
properties.description: The widget below this widget in the tree whose position will be animated.

properties.name: left
properties.description: The distance from the left edge of the stack. Can be null if not required.

properties.name: top
properties.description: The distance from the top edge of the stack. Can be null if not required.

properties.name: right
properties.description: The distance from the right edge of the stack. Can be null if not required.

properties.name: bottom
properties.description: The distance from the bottom edge of the stack. Can be null if not required.

properties.name: width
properties.description: The width of the child. If null, the child’s intrinsic width is used.

properties.name: height
properties.description: The height of the child. If null, the child’s intrinsic height is used.

properties.name: duration
properties.description: The length of time over which to animate changes to position and size.

properties.name: curve
properties.description: The animation curve to use when animating position and size changes.
properties.possible_values: Any Flutter animation curve, e.g., Curves.easeInOut
